assumptions.choice: The 24-bar cooldown between entries applies to initiating a new trade sequence from flat, permitting pyramiding within the active 3-bar trade window.
assumptions.reason: Requiring a 24-bar gap for pyramiding entries would render pyramiding impossible due to the 3-bar time-based exit rule.

assumptions.choice: Take-profit and stop-loss price levels are computed at initial entry fill using the executed price, SMA(20), and initial UnitRisk.
assumptions.reason: The specification specifies fixed target and stop offsets anchored to the entry price.

assumptions.choice: Take-profit and stop-loss levels are checked against bar High and Low prices.
assumptions.reason: Price targets and stop-losses trigger intraday when High or Low crosses the corresponding level.
